exposed_pad.note: 5-lead SOT25 (formerly SOT-23-5) package with no exposed thermal pad.

theta_ja_c_per_w.condition: SOT25 junction-to-ambient thermal resistance, no heatsink

tj_max_c.condition: Absolute Maximum operating junction temperature +150°C (OTSD typ +160°C, 25°C hysteresis)

pinout.name: VIN
pinout.description: Power supply input voltage (2.5 V to 6.0 V); decouple with 1.0 uF ceramic capacitor.

pinout.name: EN
pinout.description: Active-high Chip Enable (VIH >= 1.5 V on, VIL <= 0.4 V off) with internal 3.0 MOhm pull-down resistor.

pinout.name: NC
pinout.description: No internal connection (verify vs BYP/NR-pin LDOs such as AP2210K or LP2985).

pinout.name: VOUT
pinout.description: Regulated 3.3 V output with internal 60 Ohm active discharge resistor when EN is low.

vin_min_v.condition: Recommended operating supply voltage minimum (for 3.3 V output, maintain VIN >= 3.3 V + VDROP)

vout_tolerance_pct.condition: ±1.5% (98.5% to 101.5% of nominal VOUT) at VIN = 4.3 V, 1 mA <= IOUT <= 30 mA, TA = +25°C

iout_max_ma.condition: Guaranteed minimum continuous output current (600 mA min) at VIN = 4.3 V, VOUT = 3.251 V to 3.350 V

iq_typ_ua.condition: VIN = 4.3 V, IOUT = 0 mA, TA = +25°C (80 uA max)

ishdn_typ_ua.condition: VIN = 4.3 V, VEN in OFF mode (1.0 uA max)

dropout_typ_mv.condition: IOUT = 600 mA, VOUT = 3.3 V, TA = +25°C (400 mV max; 125 mV typ / 200 mV max at 300 mA)

psrr_db.condition: f = 100 Hz and f = 1 kHz, VIN = 4.3 V, 0.5 Vp-p ripple, IOUT = 100 mA

output_noise_uvrms.condition: No load, 10 Hz <= f <= 100 kHz, CIN = COUT = 1.0 uF ceramic

min_cout_uf.condition: 1.0 uF X7R or X5R ceramic recommended (also stable with tantalum or aluminum electrolytic)

design_gotchas.title: 6.5 V Abs Max & SOT25 Thermal Limit at 600 mA From 5 V Input
design_gotchas.detail: At VIN = 5.0 V to VOUT = 3.3 V and full 600 mA load, power dissipation reaches 1.02 W. With θJA = 184 °C/W (no heatsink), ΔT = 187.7 °C — immediately exceeding the 150 °C TJ limit and 160 °C thermal shutdown even at 25 °C ambient. In SOT25, sustained 600 mA operation requires VIN close to ~3.7–4.2 V (e.g., single-cell Li-Ion) or heavy copper heatsinking; also note 6.5 V abs max leaves minimal headroom against 5 V USB hot-plug inductive ringing.

design_gotchas.title: 50 mA Foldback Short-Circuit Limit Can Stall Startup Into Pre-Biased or Constant-Current Loads
design_gotchas.detail: Page 11 explicitly warns that if a current-sink load exceeding the 50 mA foldback current limit is present at VOUT before AP2112 is enabled, foldback limiting can prevent the regulator from starting up. Evaluate multi-rail sequencing and active-load startup waveforms carefully.

design_gotchas.title: Pin 4 Is NC (Not BYP/NR) and EN Includes Internal 3 MOhm Pull-Down + 60 Ohm Output Auto-Discharge
design_gotchas.detail: Pin 4 is unconnected (NC), so an existing bypass capacitor on Pin 4 from an AP2210K or LP2985 footprint is harmless, though replacing AP2112K with a BYP/NR-pin LDO requires verifying Pin 4 routing. Unlike floating-EN parts, EN defaults OFF via a 3.0 MOhm pull-down and discharges VOUT through 60 Ohm when disabled.

design_gotchas.title: Tight 6.0 V Recommended VIN Max vs Higher-Voltage SOT-23-5 LDOs
design_gotchas.detail: AP2112K-3.3TRG1 is rated to only 6.0 V operating / 6.5 V absolute maximum, making it unsafe as a drop-in substitute on 9 V or 12 V rails currently using AP2210K-3.3TRG1 (13.2 V operating / 15 V abs max) despite sharing Pins 1, 2, 3, and 5.

typical_use_cases: Single-cell Li-Ion (3.6 V–4.2 V) to 3.3 V power rails for ESP32/Wi-Fi/BLE MCUs needing up to 600 mA bursts
5 V USB-powered microcontroller and sensor boards needing compact SOT-23-5 enable control and fast 20 us startup
Sequenced digital sub-rails benefiting from internal 60 Ohm active output discharge when disabled
General-purpose 1 uF ceramic-cap stable 3.3 V rails in portable consumer and IoT designs
engineering_summary: The Diodes Incorporated AP2112K-3.3TRG1 is a widely deployed 600 mA fixed 3.3 V (±1.5%) CMOS LDO in a 5-pin SOT-23-5 (SOT25) package with standard 1=VIN, 2=GND, 3=EN (active high, 3 MOhm internal pull-down), 4=NC, 5=VOUT pinout. It operates from 2.5 V to 6.0 V (6.5 V abs max) with 250 mV typical dropout at 600 mA, 55 uA quiescent current, 0.01 uA shutdown current, 50 uVRMS noise, 65 dB PSRR (100 Hz/1 kHz), 60 Ohm active output discharge, and 1.0 uF ceramic cap stability. Engineers must derate load current thermally from 5 V inputs (θJA = 184 °C/W) and check 50 mA foldback startup behavior into constant-current loads.
